'''Corona''' is a [[neighborhood]] in the [[Borough (New York City)|borough]] of [[Queens]] in [[New York City]]. It borders [[Flushing, Queens|Flushing]] and [[Flushing Meadows–Corona Park]] to the east, [[Jackson Heights, Queens|Jackson Heights]] and  [[Elmhurst, Queens|Elmhurst]] to the west, [[Forest Hills, Queens|Forest Hills]] and [[Rego Park, Queens|Rego Park]] to the south, and [[East Elmhurst, Queens|East Elmhurst]] to the north. Corona's main thoroughfares include Corona Avenue, [[Roosevelt Avenue]], [[New York State Route 25A|Northern Boulevard]], [[Junction Boulevard]], and 108th Street.

Corona has a [[multicultural]] population with a [[Latin Americans|Latino]] majority, and is the site of historic [[African-American]] and [[Italian-American]] communities. After World War II, the majority of the neighborhood's residents were mostly [[Italians|Italian]], [[Germans|German]], [[Irish people|Irish]] and of other European ancestries. Corona also has a significant [[Chinese people in New York City|Chinese]] population.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.msaag.org/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/13_McGlinn.pdf|title=Beyond Chinatown: Dual immigration and the Chinese population of metropolitan New York City, 2000, pp. 114-115|author=Lawrence A. McGlinn, Department of Geography SUNY-New Paltz|publisher=Middle States Geographer, 2002, 35: 110–119, Journal of the Middle States Division of the Association of American Geographers|access-date=March 7, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402151518/http://msaag.org/wp-content/uploads/2013/05/13_McGlinn.pdf|archive-date=April 2, 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Corona is mostly part of [[Queens Community Board 4|Queens Community District 4]].<ref name="NYCPlanning4"/> The section north of Roosevelt Avenue, known as '''North Corona''', is the northern section of Corona and is in [[Queens Community Board 3|Community District 3]].<ref name="NYCPlanning3"/> Corona is patrolled by the 110th and 115th Precincts of the [[New York City Police Department]].<ref name="NYPD 110th Precinct"/>
